title: Rockstar Games Launcher Adds Revamped Chat Overlay with Discord Integration and Streamer Mode
description: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games has released a new update for the Rockstar Games Launcher (RGL), introducing a completely reworked chat overlay. According to the publication, the update includes updated visual designs, new social and achievement functionality, and full controller support.
youtubeTitle: Rockstar Launcher Update: New Chat Overlay, Discord & Streamer Mode
socialHook: Rockstar Games Launcher gets a major chat overlay update with Discord integration and streamer mode.

sections.heading: New Chat Overlay Features
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports the updated Rockstar Games Launcher introduces a revamped chat overlay featuring updated visual designs, new social and achievement functionality, and full controller support. The overlay also supports Discord connectivity for easy friend invites and includes a dedicated streamer mode, according to patch notes from the Rockstar Support website.

sections.heading: Patch Notes and Rollout
paragraphs: The publication states the update will be downloaded automatically when users next boot the launcher. RockstarINTEL highlights that the patch notes were sourced directly from the Rockstar Support site, confirming added features such as the revamped overlay, social tools, and controller support. No separate official Rockstar blog announcement has been made.

sections.heading: Context and Community Impact
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL notes development of the new chat overlay comes shortly after the launch of NoPixel V, a roleplay server Rockstar collaborated on. The outlet suggests the launcher improvements signal Rockstar's intent to maintain and enhance the platform ahead of Grand Theft Auto VI's eventual PC release, though no official timeline for GTA VI on PC has been confirmed.
